subject: Kickoff: sentence-level LMs for storyline coherence
body:
Hi all,

Kicking off better_storylines. The core idea from our open-source release: instead of token-level generation, model stories at the sentence level - each sentence represented by its mean BERT embedding - and learn to predict which sentence plausibly comes next. On ROC Stories this gives strong storyline continuation accuracy at a fraction of the cost of decoding candidates.

Product angle for data-platforms: a coherence-scoring service for the drafting assistant - flag the paragraph where a long draft loses the plot, suggest reordering. Sentence-level scoring is cheap enough to run on every keystroke pause.

Milestones: reproduce Tables 1 and 2 accuracy numbers from released checkpoints by 3/27; internal drafting-corpus embeddings + fine-tune in April; coherence service demo and readout by 5/18.

Bruno - staffing plan when you can.

Dmitri
